name: D.C. White Season ~Da Capo White Season~ Circus Amusement Disk Vol. 3
original_name: D.C. White Season ~ダ・カーポ ホワイトシーズン~ Circus Amusement Disk Vol.3
source: This is a collection of short stories depicting the heroines of "D.C ~Da Capo~" and the subsequent episodes of the protagonist, Junichi Asakura.
translation: 收录描绘《D.C. ～初音岛～》各位女主角以及主人公朝仓纯一后续日常片段的短篇故事合集。
